english.title: Fail to notify change of circumstances - immigration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with a view to obtaining

(A)_[for yourself]_
(B)_[for another, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_

support under any provision made by or under Part VI of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999, failed without reasonable excuse, to notify a change of circumstances when required to do so in accordance with a provision made by or under Part VI of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999, namely **(..SPECIFY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 105(1) and (2) of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
